summary: This concurrent resolution states that Congress appreciates law enforcement officers' daily contributions to public safety, recognizes their personal sacrifices, and expresses its full support for them.

scores.thoughts: The bill contains no references to government budgets, appropriations, or spending levels. It is a non-binding resolution expressing support for law enforcement without any fiscal provisions.
No provisions or mentions related to taxes, tax policy, or revenue measures appear in the text.
The resolution does not address healthcare systems, coverage, or policy in any way.
While law enforcement officers carry firearms, the bill makes no statements about gun regulations, rights, or policy changes.

One whereas clause criticizes sanctuary city policies for restricting cooperation with federal immigration authorities. This directly endorses stronger enforcement and border cooperation, aligning with the +1 direction of the topic.
No content related to abortion access or restrictions.
The bill focuses exclusively on domestic law enforcement and contains no references to military or defense spending.
No environmental, regulatory, or climate-related provisions are present.
The resolution does not discuss welfare programs, entitlements, or social safety net policies.
No mentions of schools, education funding, or school choice.
The bill praises law enforcement for removing dangerous drugs and notes declining overdose deaths. This implicitly supports continued enforcement-focused drug policy rather than decriminalization.

The core purpose of the resolution is to express strong support for law enforcement, criticize 'defund the police' efforts, and highlight reductions in crime under pro-law-and-order policies. This directly advances the tougher policing and enforcement side of the spectrum.
No trade, tariffs, or globalization provisions exist in the bill.
The text contains no discussion of deficits, debt reduction, or fiscal policy.
No references to LGBTQ+ issues or legal protections.
The bill does not address foreign aid or international assistance.
No content related to voting access, election integrity, or electoral procedures.
The resolution makes no statements about technology regulation or privacy.
No provisions concerning workers' rights, unions, or labor policy.
The bill does not engage with religious exemptions or anti-discrimination issues.
